build.buildCommand: export AF_NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-railway-${RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-local} && node scripts/railway-clean-next-build.cjs && npx prisma generate && npm run build && node scripts/railway-patch-app-build-manifest.cjs && node scripts/railway-verify-next-build.cjs

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:migrate:deploy && AF_NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-railway-${RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA:-local} npm run start:railway
